newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS boosts EPS estimates for Rieter.
newsitem.headline: UBS boosts EPS estimates for Rieter.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland said it had raised its earnings per share estimates for Rieter Holding AG but maintained its "hold" recommendation for shares.

"We are raising our EPS estimates for 1996 to 23.1 Swiss francs (from 21.2), for 1997 to 29.8 (24.7) and for 1998 to 36.1 (29.0)," UBS said in a research report, adding the shares were now valued similarly to Saurer stock.

"But the existing price (gain) potential of five to 10 percent after the latest price rise does not justify a 'buy' recommendation," it said. It cited cost savings, excess capacity reductions and currency factors for the upgraded estimates.
